dedupe_keys.name: chmu hydrology open data surface water and groundwater czechia

description: The Czech Hydrometeorological Institute produced this open data set for hydrology, with current, recent and historical data on water levels, discharges and water temperature on rivers, levels in springs and wells, water quality, and station characteristics, organised in folders with a description PDF. Coverage is Czechia, with the folders dated from 2024 to 2026. The files are a free download from the open directory. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (CHMI terms: products on the website are under CC BY 4.0). Simulation uses: river level and discharge series for flood hazard, warning and drought studies. Related records: the Czech dam safety supervision register (data-czech-mze-dam-safety-supervision-register). The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
